timeline.title: One counter, one idea
timeline.text: Vaishnavi Mobile Point opens in Churi Centre Gali off Ratu Road, selling recharge coupons, SIM cards and a handful of feature phones.

timeline.title: The repair bench arrives
timeline.text: A second-hand microscope and a soldering station turn a retail counter into a proper service centre.

timeline.title: Brand partnerships
timeline.text: Authorised dealership for the major Indian smartphone brands, with GST billing and sealed stock only.

timeline.title: Chip-level capability
timeline.text: Board-level repair added, taking on the jobs authorised centres turn away as "not repairable".

timeline.title: Tickets and tracking
timeline.text: Every repair gets a ticket number so customers can follow progress from home instead of calling the shop.

timeline.title: A Ratu Road landmark
timeline.text: A full storefront plus a three-bench service room, serving thousands of customers across Ranchi every year.

values.title: Tell the truth
values.text: If a repair is not worth the money we say so, even when it costs us the sale.

values.title: Genuine or nothing
values.text: Original and service-pack parts, printed on the bill so you can verify them yourself.

values.title: Explain, do not rush
values.text: Plenty of our customers are buying their first smartphone. Nobody leaves confused.

values.title: Stay reachable
values.text: Same counter, same faces, same phone number for over a decade.
